name: MoYu AoLong 3x3 V6 (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated)
description: The MoYu AoLong 3x3 V6 (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated) is the full-flagship build of the AoLong V6 line, pairing a carbon fiber core with a 20-Magnet Ball-Core, 100 total magnets, and dual edge-and-corner repulsion. If you want everything MoYu engineered into this generation without compromise, this is it.
features: Top-tier magnet count: 100 magnets covering the full range of positions for instant, precise feedback on every turn.
20-Magnet Ball-Core: all-directional drive and powerful centripetal force for more speed with less resistance.
Dual edge and corner repulsion: both systems work together for more precise alignment, greater forgiveness, and stability at high speed.
High-grip UV Coated finish: a super-glossy surface that's durable, wear-resistant, and controllable through long solves.
8×8 digital adjustment: 8 levels of MagLev elasticity and 8 levels of tension combine for 64 competition-ready feel configurations.
MagLev tension system: springs replaced by repelling magnets, free from internal resistance for silky-smooth tension adjustment.
